'''Astilbe Town''' (Japanese: '''アスチルベタウン''' ''Astilbe Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Unova]] [[region]] that appeared in ''[[BW077|Evolution by Fire!]]''. It is a village located between [[Mistralton City]] and [[Icirrus City]], and it lies directly outside of [[Twist Mountain]].

The town has a [[Battle Club]], where {{Ash}} met the [[original Trainer]] of his {{p|Tepig}}, [[Shamus]]. Ash faced Shamus in a [[Double Battle]], using his Tepig and {{AP|Snivy}} against Shamus's {{p|Heatmor}} and {{p|Emboar}}. During the battle, Tepig [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{AP|Pignite}} and proved his strength to Shamus, who offered him a spot on his [[Party|team]]. However, Pignite rejected him, preferring to stay with Ash.
